rationale: The current best still carries the quantization-safe bigram head, but its scale starts at zero, which blocks bigram_out and bigram_in from learning on the first step. This change keeps the branch initially silent by zero-initializing bigram_out, while giving it a nonzero scale so the head can start learning immediately under the 600-second step budget.
title: Wake Bigram Head Early On Recurrent-Tail Best
